customManagers.description: Track the cosign CLI version pinned for signing, independent of the cosign-installer action version
Track zizmor releases on PyPI (installed with uvx, so pypi is the datasource -- not a container image, so the digest-pin exclusion above does not apply)

Track bootc-dev/bootc release + pinned commit. github-tags (not github-releases) so Renovate can resolve BOOTC_COMMIT as the tag's digest and keep it in sync with BOOTC_VERSION on every bump, the same way GitHub Actions pins update their trailing-comment tag alongside the pinned SHA.

packageRules.description: Automerge every Renovate update once the PR build is green. The PR build compiles all three flavors (base/kde/xfce) from the Containerfile, so a broken bump fails here rather than reaching main. Note it does not boot-test the image, and it skips the rechunk/push/sign steps (those are gated to non-PR events) -- a change that builds but breaks first boot or `bootc upgrade` would still merge. Failures surface as a red build on main via GitHub notifications.

Never automerge a major bootc-dev/bootc bump. The PR build only proves the Containerfile still compiles bootc and passes `bootc container lint` -- it does not boot-test the image, so a breaking change to bootc's on-disk format, CLI, or upgrade behavior would still merge automatically under the general rule above. Every other update type for this package (digest, pin, patch, minor), and every other update type for every other package, keeps automerging.
